title: Isoimperatorin alleviates fungal keratitis by regulating NF-kappaB pathway and macrophage immune response.
authors: Song, Shiqi; Xu, Huirong; Liu, Mengzhu; Xu, Qiang; Wang, Ling; Wang, Fenglei; Wan, Xiaomei; Sun, Xiaoyan; Che, Chengye
one_liner_zh: 研究异欧前胡素通过TLR4/NF-κB通路调节真菌性角膜炎免疫反应，仅涉及分子对接验证药物-靶点结合，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: PURPOSE: The purpose of this research study was to investigate the impact of isoimperatorin on Aspergillus fumigatus (A. fumigatus) keratitis and elucidate its underlying mechanisms via the TLR4/MyD88/IKK/NF-kappaB signaling pathway. MATERIALS AND METHODS: The targets of the active ingredient isoimperatorin were identified via network pharmacology. Key interactions between isoimperatorin and its predicted targets were validated using molecular docking. In vitro RAW264.7 macrophage cells of A. fumigatus keratitis, the effects of isoimperatorin on inflammatory signaling and cell apoptosis were assessed using western blotting, immunofluorescence, and flow cytometry. In vivo C57BL/6 mouse models of A. fumigatus keratitis, the effects of isoimperatorin on inflammatory signaling, neutrophil infiltration, macrophage polarization, and cell apoptosis were assessed using quantitative real-time polymerase chain reaction (qRT-PCR), western blotting and immunofluorescence. RESULTS: Isoimperatorin inhibited TLR4/MyD88 complex formation and IKK/NF-kappaB phosphorylation, downregulated pro-inflammatory cytokines, reduced neutrophil infiltration, and promoted macrophage polarization from the M1 to the M2 phenotype. Additionally, it inhibited cell apoptosis and alleviated corneal epithelial damage. CONCLUSION: This study demonstrates that isoimperatorin exerts a protective effect against A. fumigatus keratitis primarily by modulating the host immune response. The mechanism is mediated through the multi-target inhibition of the TLR4/MyD88/IKK/NF-kappaB pathway, leading to a coordinated reduction in inflammation and tissue damage. These findings highlight the therapeutic potential of isoimperatorin as a novel immunomodulatory strategy for managing fungal keratitis.
abstract_zh: 目的：本研究旨在探讨异欧前胡素对烟曲霉（A. fumigatus）角膜炎的影响，并阐明其通过TLR4/MyD88/IKK/NF-kappaB信号通路的潜在机制。材料与方法：通过网络药理学鉴定活性成分异欧前胡素的靶点。利用分子对接验证异欧前胡素与其预测靶点之间的关键相互作用。在体外烟曲霉角膜炎RAW264.7巨噬细胞模型中，采用蛋白质印迹法、免疫荧光和流式细胞术评估异欧前胡素对炎症信号和细胞凋亡的影响。在体内烟曲霉角膜炎C57BL/6小鼠模型中，采用实时定量聚合酶链反应（qRT-PCR）、蛋白质印迹法和免疫荧光评估异欧前胡素对炎症信号、中性粒细胞浸润、巨噬细胞极化和细胞凋亡的影响。结果：异欧前胡素抑制TLR4/MyD88复合物形成及IKK/NF-kappaB磷酸化，下调促炎细胞因子，减少中性粒细胞浸润，并促进巨噬细胞从M1向M2表型极化。此外，它还抑制细胞凋亡并减轻角膜上皮损伤。结论：本研究证明异欧前胡素主要通过调节宿主免疫反应对烟曲霉角膜炎发挥保护作用。其机制通过多靶点抑制TLR4/MyD88/IKK/NF-kappaB通路介导，导致炎症和组织损伤的协同减轻。这些发现凸显了异欧前胡素作为一种新型免疫调节策略治疗真菌性角膜炎的潜力。
